title: Only the launcher touches the cache, and only it decides what is kept
caption: A developer reaches Accelerator through Claude Code, which loads its skills; every skill that needs a binary goes through the launcher. The cache is new as a container in its own right: before this change the launcher treated it as scratch space, and now it holds the claims that decide what survives.
